title: Device routes
connecting: Choose the device and complete pairing if prompted.
unsupported: Bluetooth requires Web Bluetooth on HTTPS or localhost, or the desktop app.
name: Route
paused: Transfer paused. Continue with the same device and route data.
verifyPaused: Validation result is pending. Continue to check the device.
protocol: The device returned an invalid MCUmgr response.
timeout: The device did not respond in time. Continue to check the transfer status.
version: The device returned an unsupported route protocol or file format version.
notFound: The route or upload transaction no longer exists.
exists: The device could not allocate a new route file. Start a new upload.
inUseError: This route is in use. Exit route preview or navigation on the device before deleting it.
noSpace: Not enough storage space. Delete an unused route and try again.
limit: The route count or file limits were exceeded. Remove a route or reduce its size or complexity.
incomplete: The device has not received the complete file. Continue the transfer.
invalidRoute: The device rejected the route's checksum or structure.
unsupportedFormat: The device does not support this route format.
expired: The upload expired or the device restarted. Send the route again.
stale: The device route list changed. Review the refreshed list and try again.
busy: The device is busy. Try again shortly.
storage: The device could not access route storage.
argument: The device rejected the request parameters.
connectionHelp: This connection is shared by route transfers and firmware updates. Closing this window keeps the connection.
taskLocked: Finish the current task before changing the connection.
endTaskHelp: This stops tracking the transfer and releases the connection for other tasks. It does not cancel processing or remove data already written on the device.
